clips.name: Idle
clips.direction: Subtle breathing, eye motion optional, feet/root completely fixed. Must remain spatially stationary for 10s loop test.

clips.name: Walk
clips.direction: Natural chibi walk cycle; foot plant readable; no global translation baked.

clips.name: Run
clips.direction: True leg run cycle with body lean and weight shift. Never move whole character as a flat sprite.

clips.name: Turn
clips.direction: Readable torso/head/hip turn. Not a mirrored instant swap. Export both sides only if asymmetry requires.

clips.name: JumpStart
clips.direction: Compression -> push-off. Game physics owns vertical translation.

clips.name: JumpLoop
clips.direction: Airborne rising/neutral loop pose; keep feet baseline normalized in render output.

clips.name: DoubleJump
clips.direction: Clear second impulse: tuck, twist, leg kick or compact spin; visually distinct from first jump.

clips.name: Fall
clips.direction: Falling silhouette with slightly raised arms/hair lift; game physics owns descent.

clips.name: Land
clips.direction: Contact, knee compression, recovery. No foot sliding.

clips.name: Attack01
clips.direction: Fast opening slash. Body twist and weapon arm motion must be real.

clips.name: Attack02
clips.direction: Second combo beat: opposite-direction or rising slash; more weight than Attack01.

clips.name: Attack03
clips.direction: Heavy finisher with largest body rotation, strongest anticipation and follow-through.

clips.name: SkillU
clips.direction: Close-range 回风斩. Full-body spin/arc with clear anticipation and recovery.

clips.name: SkillI
clips.direction: 星芒弹 cast: gather -> aim -> release -> recoil/recover. Projectile is separate VFX, not baked into body pose.

clips.name: Dash
clips.direction: Strong forward body lean, compressed silhouette and trailing hair/sleeves. Movement handled by game.

clips.name: Musou
clips.direction: Complete burst performance: charge -> multi-hit/finisher -> recovery. Not a static pose with a circle effect.

clips.name: HurtLight
clips.direction: Small recoil; head/shoulder reaction; recover quickly.

clips.name: HurtHeavy
clips.direction: Clearly stronger than HurtLight: torso fold, arm throw, delayed recovery.

clips.name: Knockback
clips.direction: Body driven backward with feet losing contact/drag pose. Game applies position displacement.

clips.name: Stun
clips.direction: Looping dazed body sway; feet stay planted. Status icon/VFX separate.

clips.name: Knockdown
clips.direction: Loss of balance to grounded pose. Distinct from knockback.

clips.name: Getup
clips.direction: Grounded -> kneel -> stand; end exactly aligned to Idle baseline.

clips.name: Death
clips.direction: Readable defeat with final hold pose. No abrupt disappearing.

clips.name: Cultivate
clips.direction: True seated cultivation/meditation pose with subtle breathing and sleeve/hair secondary motion.

clips.name: Victory
clips.direction: Short celebratory pose suitable for stage clear.

clips.name: Interact
clips.direction: Generic hand-forward interaction usable for shrine/NPC/object.

clips.name: CastStart
clips.direction: Enter casting posture; transitions to CastLoop.

clips.name: CastLoop
clips.direction: Looping sustained cast posture. No baked projectile/VFX.
